messages:
elaine-partnerships: Quick sync — we need to lock the marketplace microsite sequencing and press cadence. Partner logos, joint blog, and cloud marketplace listing all need to go live within the same 72h window. who has final asset ETA?
sam-marketing: I can own the blog + social plan. need final partner quotes by EOD Wed. press embargo?
maya-pr: prefer embargoed release on Thurs 09:00 PT. can do embargo if partners agree. need headline & 1-pager by Tue.
natalie-partner: Partners OK with Thurs AM embargo but two partners want logo size/alt-text specs. sending assets in thread.
jorge-engineering: Heads-up: marketplace listing requires a small manifest and a 1-click deploy link. I'll need the final container image tag and human-readable doc by Wed noon.
liam-product: We should gate the microsite feature flags so we can flip if partner assets miss the embargo. suggested flags: marketplace_microsite_live, partner_badge_override.
elaine-partnerships: +1 on feature flags. natalie — can you confirm all logos are SVG and color-safe?
natalie-partner: Confirmed most SVGs, one PNG fallback. will upload to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/partners/mkt_assets
sam-marketing: Draft blog outline posted: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-blog — please add partner quotes inline by Wed 11:00.
maya-pr: PR draft in progress. tagging wire: @presslist, press contacts table included. quick ask: any embargo exceptions?
elaine-partnerships: No exceptions unless legal signs off.
jorge-engineering: For the manifest, copy below. please confirm image tag and marketplace description:
```json
{
  "name": "redwood-marketplace-example",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "image": "redwood/inference:REPLACE_WITH_TAG",
  "deploy": { "cloud": "gcp", "region": "us-west1" }
}
```
liam-product: I'll generate the feature flag names and add to rollout plan. tagging eng-sre for canary window: 2 hours post-launch.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-microsite at 1967890600 by jorge-engineering (auto).
sam-marketing: Small checklist from marketing: 1) final blog with quotes, 2) microsite screenshots, 3) social assets (all sizes). target upload Wed noon.
natalie-partner: Uploaded logos + copy. one partner requested co-branded screenshot — can design produce by Wed morning?
elaine-partnerships: @design-team can we prioritize a co-brand hero by Wed 10:00?
maya-pr: I'll circulate embargo list + media pitch draft after headline sign-off.
jorge-engineering: Noted. will update manifest with final tag once QA approves image.
liam-product: If anything slips, we'll flip marketplace_microsite_live=false and proceed with single-partner launch flow.
elaine-partnerships: Thanks all — next mini-check at Tue 15:00 PT. please flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
